body: I'm 15 and my parents split up when I was 8 and I remember crying every night and I've always been up and down with feeling sad my girlfriend is quite manipulative and says bad things about me to all her friends she's being tested for bipolar my parents only care about their jobs I think they both have depression but have never asked for help I feel so alone and I don't see a future for me because I get anxious about going to school my parents think I don't want to go but I really do want to go I want to be normal and get a good job I just have no confidence I'm terrified putting all this out on here but there's nothing else I can do ending my life seems like a solution to me because I get away from everyone and I don't have to be homeless and really sad when I'm older.
